purpose: Isolated exact merged-source compiler rebuild for FlagTree PR1540; not a GPU Gate result

source.head: c0e8d152cde3194ce4a4c09fe3596abf7e36535b
source.method: GitHub source archive uploaded to owned remote directory; tracked tree exactly reconstructed; original signed merge commit object restored byte-for-byte and verified by Git object SHA. Parent history is a declared shallow boundary.

build.isolation: Owned task directory, runc CPU-only container, original compiler and deps read-only; no original venv or host-driver modifications
build.ci_toolchain_difference: Original CI used /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/mlir/llvm_artifact. This rebuild uses repository-declared f6ded0be official LLVM dev package; therefore original CI wheel size/hash differ.
build.dependency_binary_inputs: Bundled libflagcx.so/libflagcx_device.bc and NVIDIA assembler/disassembler tools reused read-only from baseline compiler; input hashes recorded in logs/readonly-baseline-inputs.sha256.
build.raw_first_build_container_status: Nonzero after successful wheel/install because the first CPU-only ABI invocation omitted the original external CUDA13 FlagCX and driver-library mounts. No compiler rebuild/source change was needed; final explicit mounts passed.

verification.flagcx_runtime_requirement: Use original external CUDA13 FlagCX package before bundled legacy CUDA12 fallback; import torch first. No collective extension ABI qualification is claimed.
verification.cpu_abi_environment: runc with no GPU devices; host libcuda/NVML libraries bind-mounted read-only solely to load TLE dependencies

source_mlir_regressions.runner: lit23.1.6, normal LIT_USE_INTERNAL_SHELL=1, j2; unchanged source config

verification.no_claim: Compiler build/CPU ABI pass does not establish MHC or Marlin G5/G6 pass
verification.packaging_install_retry: First installation exceeded the explicitly bounded1GB container tmpfs; host volume had11TB free. Reused the same build1wheel with task-owned disk TMPDIR; no recompile or repack, no existing prefix overwritten.

initial_artifact_correction.cause: Explicit external TRITON_* asset env values made setup.py download_and_copy return before copying into wheel package_data.
initial_artifact_correction.initial_size_difference_explanation_corr: Missing CUDA assets contributed to349MB vs originalCI395MB; LLVM dependency differences alone were not a valid complete explanation.
